given_when_then.given: A Delivery Partner submits a delivery proof via external API
given_when_then.when: The system validates the authenticity and completeness of the received delivery proof
given_when_then.then: The system rejects the delivery proof if the associated Delivery Assignment is marked as cancelled

given_when_then.given: A Delivery Partner completes a physical handover and captures a digital signature
given_when_then.then: The system validates the proof and releases funds to the Store Partner

given_when_then.given: A Delivery Partner captures a delivery proof that lacks a timestamp or valid signature
given_when_then.then: The system creates a Dispute Ticket

given_when_then.given: The system retrieves a delivery proof from an external courier API
given_when_then.when: The system validates the authenticity and completeness of the received delivery proof
given_when_then.then: The system treats the external proof with the same verification standards as locally captured proof

given_when_then.given: A Store Partner requests a status update for an order with no valid delivery proof recorded
given_when_then.then: The system does not update the order status and holds funds

given_when_then.given: A Delivery Partner submits a delivery proof retrieved via external API
given_when_then.when: The external courier API returns an invalid or missing delivery confirmation
given_when_then.then: The system creates a Dispute Ticket and blocks fund release

success_criteria: Delivery Assignment must be validated for cancellation status before processing any delivery proof
Delivery proof must contain a valid timestamp and signature to be accepted
Funds shall not be released to the Store Partner until a valid delivery proof is recorded in the system
Dispute Ticket must be created if the delivery proof lacks a timestamp or valid signature
External delivery proofs must undergo the same verification standards as locally captured proofs
Order status must not be updated without a valid delivery proof being recorded first
